description: This file defines the ProjectRepository class, which manages database operations related to projects, including CRUD operations, searching, cloning, and visibility checks within a PHP application.

classes.name: ProjectRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing project data in the database, including CRUD, search, clone, and visibility check operations.

methods.name: isVisibleToUser
methods.description: Checks if a project is visible to a specific user based on project visibility and user association.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a project record by its ID.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search for projects based on given criteria, with optional pagination.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Clones an existing project and its tasks, assigning it to a user.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new project record into the database.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a project by its ID.

methods.name: updateById
methods.description: Updates a project record by its ID with new column values.

methods.name: getBaseSelectQueryBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a base SQL select query builder for project data.
